activation_disposition.reason: The canonical transcriptomic checkpoint is byte-addressable, but weight terms, checkpoint-specific corpus aliases, strict held-donor preprocessing, task and split definitions, and a rights-cleared donor-level MASLD spatial dataset are unresolved.

architecture_contract.resolution_warning: The canonical human checkpoint was trained on image-based single-cell spatial assays. Applying it to Visium spots is cross-resolution transfer and requires spot-native baselines.
architecture_contract.non_native_modalities: CODEX proteins and MALDI metabolites are not native inputs to the canonical checkpoint. The optional source-code H&E path does not prove that the registered transcriptomic checkpoint was H&E-trained.

implementation.publication_title: Novae: a graph-based foundation model for spatial transcriptomics data

registered_checkpoint.warning: The immutable repository revision is pinned, but the model repository declares no license field or license file. Later card edits did not change the registered config or weight blobs.

checkpoint_code_alignment.finding: The selected v1.1.1 source postdates the 2024 checkpoint bytes. It is the current official loading implementation, not a demonstrated archive of the checkpoint-producing environment.
checkpoint_code_alignment.required_gate: Prove strict tensor restoration and fixed-fixture representation parity before treating the source and checkpoint as one executable identity.

input_and_preprocessing_contract.counts: The native automatic path may copy raw integer counts, normalize library totals, and log-transform expression.
input_and_preprocessing_contract.feature_vocabulary: Intersect query genes with the 60,697-entry checkpoint vocabulary under a frozen identifier and case policy; preserve the exact ordered intersection and out-of-vocabulary mask.
input_and_preprocessing_contract.highly_variable_genes: Automatic HVG discovery may fit the target slide or concatenated query objects. It must be disabled for a strict held-donor lane and replaced by a development-frozen feature policy.
input_and_preprocessing_contract.slide_statistics: Native preparation computes gene means and standard deviations from the supplied slide data. This uses held-donor features and is transductive even without labels.
input_and_preprocessing_contract.slide_identity: Always supply an immutable globally unique section key. The default can derive IDs from Python object identity and is not stable across processes.
input_and_preprocessing_contract.spatial_scale: Freeze the conversion from native coordinate units to microns. Pixel, array-grid, and micron distances are not interchangeable.
input_and_preprocessing_contract.missingness: Out-of-vocabulary, unmeasured, below-QC, and structurally absent genes are distinct states; do not silently treat absence from a panel as measured zero.

spatial_graph_contract.generic_default: Delaunay graph unless overridden; without a frozen radius, long edges may bridge disconnected tissue islands or biopsy cores.
spatial_graph_contract.visium_default: Grid graph with six neighbors unless overridden by the pinned implementation's declared technology-specific rule.
spatial_graph_contract.construction: Build the graph independently within an authoritative participant, core, and section boundary, then combine blocks. Never graph pooled coordinates across donors, capture arrays, slides, or fields of view.
spatial_graph_contract.required_lock: Freeze code revision, technology, coordinate source and units, scale-to-microns, neighbor or radius rule, Delaunay or grid choice, rings, percentile pruning, diagonal policy, tissue boundary masks, and adjacency and distance SHA-256 values.
spatial_graph_contract.vu2025_rule: A VLP array contains four to five participants. No graph may be constructed until each barcode or tissue island is mapped to a biopsy and participant; an array ID is never a donor ID.
spatial_graph_contract.held_donor_rule: A held donor may have a within-donor graph constructed from unlabeled coordinates under the selection-locked rule. Labels, outcomes, residuals, or outcome-guided tissue boundaries cannot influence it.

held_donor_capability.frozen_encoder_lane: Potentially supported: freeze checkpoint, feature policy, preprocessing, graph recipe, and a development-fit task head or prototype mapping, then encode a new donor's within-donor graph. This lane has not been fixture-verified.
held_donor_capability.native_zero_shot_lane: Transductive, not strict donor-inductive. In the pinned implementation, compute_representations with zero_shot=True calls target/reference K-means prototype fitting and overwrites prototype assignments using query latent features.
held_donor_capability.native_reference_all_risk: Using reference='all' pools evaluation-cohort features to refit prototypes and creates cross-donor transduction even when graphs remain section-blocked.
held_donor_capability.fine_tuning_lane: Query fine-tuning updates model state and prototypes from held features. It is a separately reported query-adaptive lane and cannot be called zero-shot or used for a sealed champion unless explicitly authorized by a prespecified transductive task.
held_donor_capability.domain_assignment: Prototype hierarchy, number of domains, Leiden resolution, leaf-to-domain mapping, and label mapping must be chosen on development donors before held-donor evaluation.

training_corpus_contract.warning: Liver and cancer-context encoder exposure is definite. The model card does not bind a checkpoint-specific accession and donor-alias manifest to the exact registered bytes, so project-cohort exposure cannot be called clean_declared.

safe_loading_contract.configuration_risk: The JSON contains a 60,697-entry gene vocabulary and must be size-bounded and schema-validated before allocation.
safe_loading_contract.required_path: After rights clearance and campaign approval, acquire only the exact immutable revision, verify filename, size, and SHA-256, mirror locally, disable network access, instantiate pinned trusted source, and require exact keys, shapes, dtypes, finite values, and vocabulary order.
safe_loading_contract.mutable_aliases: Never load latest, main, an organization alias, or an unpinned Hugging Face identifier during a campaign.

runtime_contract.required_probe: After all activation gates and campaign approval only: isolated L40S import, no-network strict load, raw-count and preprocessed fixtures, graph boundary and distance fixtures, frozen representation, native transductive zero-shot, forward, fine-tune backward, resume, deterministic seed, cell-order permutation, section-order permutation, and cross-device numeric-tolerance probes through SLURM.

terms_and_release_contract.code: BSD-3-Clause at the pinned v1.1.1 source revision.
terms_and_release_contract.checkpoint: UNRESOLVED; the canonical Hugging Face model repository has neither a license field nor a license file.
terms_and_release_contract.training_data: The aggregate dataset card's BSD tag does not by itself replace the terms of underlying 10x Genomics, Vizgen, NanoString, and study-owned sources. Source-level training and derivative-weight rights remain to be audited.
terms_and_release_contract.optional_H&E: The source-code image path depends on separately gated CONCH weights and terms and is not admitted for the canonical transcriptomic checkpoint.
terms_and_release_contract.adaptation: No checkpoint use, fine-tuning, derivative-weight release, or open champion is authorized until written weight terms and all relevant upstream data rights are resolved.

source_evidence: The Nature Methods article and Supplementary Data 1, official v1.1.1 GitHub release and raw source, official PyPI metadata, and immutable Hugging Face model metadata were inspected online on 2026-08-22. No package, checkpoint, model, dataset, or source archive was downloaded, installed, or executed.
